description: This file contains platform-specific functions for firmware upgrade and image verification tailored to different hardware boards within an OpenWrt build system. It defines functions for image checking, upgrading procedures, and handles board-specific logic for upgrade paths.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image based on the board type, with special handling for 'netgear,readynas-duo-v2'.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade tailored for specific board types, including handling for 'ctera,c200-v1', 'iptime,nas1', and various Linksys models.
